Gua Sha

Instrument-assisted
fascial release.
Breaking down
what's been stuck.

Gua sha uses a smooth-edged instrument to work along the surface of the skin, targeting fascial adhesions and restricted tissue just beneath. The technique improves circulation, breaks down scar tissue and adhesions, and restores tissue mobility in a way that manual work alone sometimes cannot reach.

Like cupping, gua sha is most effective when incorporated into an integrative session where Nikki can assess what the body needs in context.
